description: Create a transfer from an active quote. The quote must not be expired. With fundingSource fund_transfer (the default) this only creates the transfer and returns deposit instructions; no money moves until someone deposits the funds. With prefund_balance it debits your organisation's balance and starts the payout immediately, so this moves real money: get explicit human approval first. For payouts in AED, CAD, EUR, GBP, MXN, USD you must also supply recipientType, the full beneficiary address, and dateOfBirth when the recipient is an individual. To pay one of the organisation's saved beneficiaries, set destinationType to beneficiary and pass its beneficiaryId instead of bank details. The payout network comes from the quote. To pay a mobile money wallet (a mobile_money quote), keep destinationType bank and send walletProvider and walletAccount with accountHolderName, bankCountry and bankCurrency, and no bank fields. A CNY bank payout needs nameInLocalLanguage and nationalIdentificationNumber, and for goods trade (purposeCode GENERAL_GOODS_TRADES) logisticsTrackingDetails and items. A unionpay quote is a personal remittance to mainland China: purposeCode PERSONAL_REMITTANCE or USER_WITHDRAWAL. For a swap (a quote between two stablecoins or two networks), set destinationType to crypto with destinationCurrency, destinationNetwork and destinationAddress; currency and network must match the quote. A swap is funded by a deposit (fund_transfer) and needs no bank details or purposeCode.

accountHolderName.description: Account holder's full name, or the company name when recipientType is business

accountNumber.description: Bank account number, if not using IBAN

accountOwnership.description: Whose bank account the payout pays: the customer's own (first_party) or someone else's (third_party). A third_party payout needs a purposeCode, and is refused where this type of customer may only pay their own account. No effect on a crypto destination

accountType.description: Account type. Required for CAD and USD bank payouts

addressCountry.description: Beneficiary country, ISO 2-letter. The complete address is required for AED, CAD, EUR, GBP, MXN, USD

addressStreet.description: Beneficiary street address. Needed, with addressCountry, whenever an address is sent

bankAddressCountry.description: Country of the beneficiary's bank, ISO 2-letter

bankAddressPostalCode.description: Postal code of the beneficiary's bank

bankAddressState.description: State or region of the beneficiary's bank

bankAddressStreet.description: Street address of the beneficiary's bank. A bank address is required for a USD SWIFT payout to an account the paying customer does not hold; street and country at minimum

bankCountry.description: Bank country, ISO 2-letter (e.g. 'AU', 'US'). For mobile money, the country of the wallet

bankName.description: Name of the destination bank. Required unless paying a mobile money wallet

beneficiaryId.description: Saved beneficiary id when destinationType is beneficiary. It supplies the recipient and bank details, so the bank fields are ignored (logisticsTrackingDetails, items and documents still travel with the payout); archived beneficiaries are refused

customerId.description: The customer ID for this transfer

dateOfBirth.description: Beneficiary date of birth, YYYY-MM-DD. Required when recipientType is individual for AED, CAD, EUR, GBP, MXN, USD

destinationAddress.description: Wallet address when destinationType is crypto. It must be valid on destinationNetwork: funds sent to a wrong address cannot be recovered

destinationCurrency.description: Stablecoin to deliver when destinationType is crypto (e.g. 'USDT'). Must match the quote's destination currency

destinationNetwork.description: Blockchain network when destinationType is crypto (e.g. 'polygon'). Must match the quote's destination network

destinationType.description: Payout target: a bank account (off-ramp), a wallet address (swap), or a saved beneficiary

documents.description: Supporting documents for the payout, such as an invoice or contract

base64Url.description: The document as a base64 data URI (e.g. 'data:application/pdf;base64,...')

fundingSource.description: fund_transfer (default) creates the transfer and returns deposit instructions; nothing moves until a person deposits the funds. prefund_balance debits your organisation's balance and starts the payout immediately, so it needs explicit human approval. Check get_balance first: transfers_enabled must be true and the quote's source asset must be held on its network

items.description: Goods the payout pays for, as invoice lines. Required, with logisticsTrackingDetails, for a CNY bank payout with purposeCode GENERAL_GOODS_TRADES

unitPrice.description: Price of one unit in the destination currency, major units, as a decimal string (e.g. '20.00')

logisticsTrackingDetails.description: Shipment tracking for the goods the payout pays for. Required, with items, for a CNY bank payout with purposeCode GENERAL_GOODS_TRADES

nameInLocalLanguage.description: Account holder name in the local language (e.g. Chinese characters for CNY)

nationalIdentificationNumber.description: National identification number of the account holder

payIdType.description: PayID alias type. Required when payId is given

paymentRail.description: USD payouts only: prefer ACH or wire. Omit for the account's default. A rail that is not available is refused

paymentReference.description: Text sent with a bank payout so the recipient can tell what it is for, such as an invoice number. Up to 35 characters: letters, digits, spaces and / - ? : ( ) . , ' + only. Some payouts carry less and refuse a reference that does not fit. No effect on a crypto destination

phone.description: Beneficiary phone number in E.164 format (e.g. '+5215512345678')

purposeCode.description: Purpose of the transfer (e.g. 'SALARY'). Required on some corridors

recipientType.description: Beneficiary type. Required for AED, CAD, EUR, GBP, MXN, USD

sourceWallet.description: Custody of the wallet the customer will send from, for the travel rule. Defaults to self_hosted when omitted

type.description: hosted when the sending wallet belongs to an exchange or other VASP, self_hosted when the customer controls the keys

vaspId.description: Travel Rule directory id of the VASP hosting the wallet, when type is hosted

vaspName.description: Name of the VASP hosting the wallet, when type is hosted

walletAccount.description: Mobile money only: the wallet's identifier, such as its mobile number (e.g. '+233241234567'). Required with walletProvider

walletAccountType.description: Mobile money only: the kind of identifier in walletAccount. Only needed where the wallet provider accepts more than one

walletProvider.description: Mobile money only: the wallet provider code, as listed for the corridor (e.g. 'mtn_gh'). Requires walletAccount, and every bank field (bankName, accountNumber, iban, bank codes) must be left out

name: create_transfer
title: Create transfer (moves money)
